title: Completed-module presentation of an affine formal map
statement: Let X be affine Noetherian and J ideal sheaf data. Let H be coherent, N a coherent formal module, and δ : N → completion(H) have uniformly ideal-power-annihilated component kernels and cokernels. Put A=Γ(X,⊤), I=J(⊤), S=AdicCompletion I A, L=tilde followed by pullback along X≅Spec A, and C=L followed by formal completion. There exist A-module P and S-module Q, an S-linear map φ:Q→S⊗P, ε:L(P)≅H, ρ:N≅C(Q restricted to A), and η:C(P)≅C(S⊗P), with η equal to completion of the tensor unit. Under these comparisons δ is completion of φ, followed by η inverse and completion of ε. Some positive I-power annihilates the A-linear kernel and cokernel of φ. This is a presentation only, without constructing an algebraized module.

proof.text: Use the proved affine coherent tilde presentation to choose P and ε. The existing completion base-change unit lemma makes η the asIso of the completed tensor unit, so its required hom equation is rfl.
Apply the affine formal-map limit dictionary to get Q, φ, ρ and the commuting square of A-linear equivalences a,b to the actual section-limit map.

Apply the fixed-exponent affine-limit implication of Remark 0888 on the affine top open, with exponent 2*t. Transfer both annihilator bounds through the commuting linear square using the proved kernel and quotient-range argument.

lean.statement:
theorem affine_formal_map_presentation
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsAffine X] (J : X.IdealSheafData)
    (H : CoherentModules X) (N : CoherentFormalModule X J)
    (δ : N ⟶ (completion X J).obj H)
    (htorsion : ∃ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t ∧ ∀ e : ℕ,
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι t).2
        (kernel (δ.hom.app (op e)))) ∧
      IsZero (Scheme.idealModuleProduct (Scheme.idealSheafPower J.toModulesι t).2
        (cokernel (δ.hom.app (op e))))) :
    let A := Γ(X, ⊤)
    let I := J.ideal ⟨⊤, isAffineOpen_top X⟩
    let S := AdicCompletion I A
    let L := tilde.functor A ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pullback X.isoSpec.hom
    let C := L ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor J
    ∃ (P : ModuleCat.{u} A) (Q : ModuleCat.{u} S),
      letI := Module.restrictScalars A S Q
      letI := IsScalarTower.restrictScalars A S Q
      ∃ (φ : Q →ₗ[S] S ⊗[A] P) (ε : L.obj P ≅ H.obj)
        (ρ : N.obj ≅ C.obj (ModuleCat.of A Q))
        (η : C.obj P ≅ C.obj (ModuleCat.of A (S ⊗[A] P))),
        η.hom = C.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (TensorProduct.mk A S P (1 : S))) ∧
        δ.hom = ρ.hom ≫ C.map (ModuleCat.ofHom (φ.restrictScalars A)) ≫
          η.inv ≫ (formalCompletionFunctor J).map ε.hom ∧
        ∃ t : ℕ, 1 ≤ t ∧
          I ^ t ≤ Module.annihilator A (φ.restrictScalars A).ker ∧
          I ^ t ≤ Module.annihilator A ((S ⊗[A] P) ⧸ (φ.restrictScalars A).range)
